## Architecture guardrails (archfit)

- Before you add an import across modules, ask: `archfit policy can-import -c microservices.archfit.yaml <file> <target>`.
  A `denied` answer names the rule and the repair. `unconstrained` is not permission.
- Before you finish, run `archfit check -c microservices.archfit.yaml --format agent` and follow `next_action`.
  `none` is a correct finish, even with exit code 2.
- Never edit `microservices.archfit.yaml`, the baseline, waivers, or labels to make a check pass.
  Ask the architecture owner instead.

### Modules

| Module | Paths | Layer | Owner | Public | Depends on | Visible to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orders_svc` | `services/orders/**` | domain | team-orders | `services/orders/api/**` | any | any |
| `payments_svc` | `services/payments/**` | domain | team-payments | `services/payments/api/**` | any | any |
| `shared_contracts` | `pkg/contracts/**` | transport | team-platform | `pkg/contracts/**` | any | any |

Layers, inner to outer: `domain`, `transport`. A layer may import only itself and layers inner to it.

### Rules that block

All code:

- `no_module_cycles`: must not close a dependency cycle between declared modules.
- `public_api_only`: may import another module only through that module's `public` paths.

Code in `services/orders/**`:

- `orders_no_payments_internal`: must not import `services/payments/internal/**`.

Code in `services/payments/**`:

- `payments_no_orders_internal`: must not import `services/orders/internal/**`.
